gap_details.2011-2012: No roster capture: Wayback has current-residents.html only 2011-05 (content last modified Oct 2010, i.e. 2010-11) and 2012-09; Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2012 has only the residency-program index; no 2011 CC crawls. problems: Old site omitted interns in 2012-13 and 2013-14 and chiefs lingered after graduating (stale rows for Baker 2013-14, Mansfield 2016-17, Hruska 2017-18, Aljuboori 2020-21, Sharma Oct 2022 were dropped or avoided). The 2012 intern class is never observed. 2023-24 roster incomplete. Program was 6 years for classes up to 2012 (graduation at PGY-6), 7 years from the 2013 class. Alumni page not yet updated for 2025 (Jani) or 2026. Raja Jani (PGY-7 2024-25 only, D.O., previously Rutgers neurosurgery per PubMed) may be a transfer-in or an enfolded fellow; not verified. Mayur Sharma (joined 2018 as PGY-1, PGY-2 by Mar 2019, graduated 2022) had advanced standing. Mansfield not on the Oct-2010 roster yet PGY-3 in 2012-13: possible joiner hidden by the 2011-12 gap. PHASE 2: no significant gaps remain. 2023-24 has a manual supplement entry alongside the observed Jun-2024 version.

2011-2012.reason: No capture, but every cohort slot is accounted for (1/yr): 2006 Shah+Franklin grad 2011; 2007 Baker; 2008 Rhee; 2009 Kinsman+Hall; 2010 Chojecka (left, later Yale neurology) replaced by Mansfield (PGY-2 2011-12, grad 2016); 2011 Hruska (NPI Apr 2011). Only a person who entered Jul 2011 and left by Jul 2012 could be hidden, above complement.

2012-2013.reason: PGY-1s not listed. The 2012 recruit Nazar entered at PGY-2 (not on Jul-2012 version, PGY-2 by Apr 2013). A 2012-13 PGY-1 would have been PGY-2 in 2013-14 and nobody is; the program already carried 7 residents (over 1/yr x 6); alumni list has no 2018 or 2019 graduate. So the 2012 PGY-1 class was empty; only an intern who left within 2012-13 could be hidden.

2013-2014.reason: Only PGY-1 (Aljuboori, PGY-2 in 2014-15, grad 2020) omitted; complement 1; no PGY-2 cohort exists (see 2012-13).

2015-2016.reason: Spring capture only, but all PGYs consistent with 2014-15 and 2016-17.

2023-2024.reason: Only version (Jun 2024) omits PGY-1s and PGY-6. Supplemented with reconstructed Leavitt+Walek (PGY-1; complement 2, NPPES 2023) and Jani (PGY-6, Rutgers->Louisville 2023). Remaining uncertainty is only Pearson's exit date (end of 2022-23 most likely vs mid-2023-24); his outcome is recorded.

2025-2026.reason: Complete (spring capture, PGYs consistent with live).
